<div class="content-intro"><p><em>&nbsp;</em></p></div><p>EQT is looking for an Application Security Engineer to join our Cyber Security Engineering team, owning the security posture of our hosted applications and container platforms. This is a hands-on engineering role where you will build automated guardrails and real-time visibility — making the secure path the easy path across a modern, globally distributed technology landscape. Over time, this role will grow to include ownership of our AI and agentic platform security as that discipline matures at EQT.</p>
